methodology.normalization: casefold, remove non-word/non-space characters, collapse whitespace
methodology.matching: exact equality of normalized sets; no substring, span, semantic, alias, or one-to-one matching
methodology.aggregation: original report averages per-case F1; audit additionally reports pooled micro counts and F1
methodology.empty_sets: precision is 0 for no predictions; recall is 1 only when both expected and actual are empty
methodology.stance_missing: missing topic/score pairs are excluded from MAE/RMSE/correlation; zero baseline uses all reference stance values
methodology.performance: wall-clock HTTP request duration including generation and parsing; no warmup isolation; generated tokens/s from provider completion tokens divided by wall time

hardware.assessment: Model IDs alone do not establish quantization, GPU offload, VRAM, RAM, context length, or KV-cache usage. These require LM Studio runtime telemetry or process/GPU measurements.
